body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-001-product-vision.md. Do not edit that file or specs/001-product-vision/spec.md. Prices below are fictional and labeled source fictional. Do not call a live retailer, bank, or Gemini API in tests. Do not commit secrets. Rails stay empty; P3 freezes them later. Money is integer LKR. A percent discount is (amount * rate_bps) // 10000.

Add POST /v1/receipts on the existing FastAPI app. The body is raw image bytes, maximum 4 MB. Over 4 MB returns 413.

The handler calls a model client with those bytes and a JSON schema for lines of raw, sku_id or null, qty, and confidence. It parses that JSON into the response. It does not write the bytes to disk, object storage, or logs.

A process-local counter allows 30 extract calls per clock minute. Call 31 in the same minute returns 429 and does not call the model. Tests pass a clock that stays inside one minute.

tests/test_receipt_api.py uses a fake client and a fake storage object. Assert the client received the bytes, the parsed lines match the fake JSON, the storage object recorded zero writes, and call 31 returns 429.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Extract calls the model, drops the bytes, and rate-limits. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_receipt_api.py::test_extract_calls_model_and_drops_image_bytes -q
title: Extract a receipt without storing the image
